user.title: Add a room
user.description: Net heat flow into or out of a room and the room's real temperature, from the AC power and the room temperature. A model of the room (air and mass) is learned from the data. If Home Assistant's recorder has the last days of the sensors, it is fitted right away; otherwise after about 12 hours with the AC switching on and off. Efficiency (COP) and model settings are under Configure afterwards.

data_description.temperature_sensor: A sensor you trust. The AC's own sensor sits in the air stream.
data_description.power_sensor: W or kW, electrical input (preferred) or thermal output. Midea-based units: the compressor power is reliable; the real-time power is decoded wrongly on some models (only about a third of the real value).
data_description.power_type: Electrical input is multiplied by the COP. Thermal output must be signed (positive heating, negative cooling) unless a climate entity is given.
data_description.climate_entity: Tells heating from cooling (hvac_action, else the hvac mode). Required for electrical power.
data_description.compressor_sensor: Optional. While off, the AC adds no heat (standby and fan power are ignored).
data_description.coil_temperature_sensor: Optional but recommended: heat only counts once the coil is warm (the indoor fan waits for it, and after a defrost), detects defrost, and improves the COP.

error.climate_required: Electrical power has no sign: pick the AC climate entity so heating and cooling can be told apart.
error.outdoor_entity_required: Pick the outdoor temperature entity, or choose another source.

data_description.power_sensor: Midea-based units: the compressor power is reliable; the real-time power is decoded wrongly on some models.
data_description.power_type: Electrical input is multiplied by the COP. Thermal output must be signed unless a climate entity is given.
data_description.outdoor_source: For the COP model. Open-Meteo uses the Home Assistant location and needs no account. Avoid sensors in the sun.
data_description.outdoor_entity: A temperature sensor or a weather entity. Only used with the source "Entity".
data_description.pause_entities: Binary sensors, switches, input booleans or sun.sun (while above the horizon). That time doesn't count for fitting the model; the live estimates keep running. Example: a window contact.

efficiency.name: Efficiency (COP)
efficiency.description: Only used for electrical power. The EU energy label gives SCOP (heating) and SEER (cooling); they roughly correspond to 7 °C and 25 °C outdoors. For EN 14511 rated values use 7 °C and 35 °C.

data_description.cop_mode: Model: the value follows indoor, outdoor (and coil) temperature like a heat pump does. Fixed: always the value entered.

model.name: Room model
model.description: The room is modelled as air and mass (furniture, wall surfaces). Its parameters are fitted to the recent history for the best 15 to 60 minute forecasts.

data_description.history_days: A few days with the AC switching on and off. Longer histories average out more, but adapt slower and take longer to fit.
data_description.refit_hours: A new fit replaces the old one only if it forecasts at least as well.
data_description.live_minutes: Window of the measured temperature rate sensor.
